ITEM 1 | Crumbly white soft cheese-like mass, off-white with slight cream tint, irregular clumps and crumbles spread across upper-left and right of plate, moist-looking, no sheen, holds rough clumped shape, roughly 40% of plate area, about 2 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Olive-green sauce with visible small seeds and chunky texture, glossy wet sheen, spooned on top of the white crumbles and sweet potato, spread across centre of plate covering about 20% of plate, about 1 cm thick | 60
ITEM 3 | Cubed orange-brown pieces with browned, slightly caramelized edges and matte surface, cubes about 2 cm per side, clustered lower-right of plate covering about 15% of plate, firm, roasted appearance | 110
ITEM 4 | Watermelon-style pink-red fruit cubes, bright red flesh with slightly moist surface, cubes about 2.5 cm per side, arranged lower-left of plate covering about 15% of plate, firm and juicy, no cooking marks | 120
